name: Titanium.Android.NotificationChannel
description:
You can create a notification channel for each distinct type of notification you need to send.

To create a notification channel, use the [Titanium.Android.createNotificationChannel](api:Titanium.Android#createNotificationChannel) method.

Further Reading:

  * [Android Developers: Notification Channel](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/app/NotificationChannel.html)

examples.title: Notification Channel Example

properties.name: bypassDnd
properties.summary: Whether or not notifications posted to this channel can interrupt the user.

properties.name: description
properties.summary: User visible description of this channel.

properties.name: enableLights
properties.summary: Whether notifications posted to this channel should display notification lights

properties.name: enableVibration
properties.summary: Whether notification posted to this channel should vibrate.

properties.name: groupId
properties.summary: Group id this channel belongs to.

properties.name: id
properties.summary: The channel id specified for the notification channel.

properties.name: importance
properties.summary: The audio stream type to use when playing the sound.
properties.description: Specify one of the `IMPORTANCE` constants from [Titanium.Android](api:Titanium.Android).

properties.name: lightColor
properties.summary: The notification light color for notifications posted to this channel.

properties.name: lockscreenVisibility
properties.summary: Whether or not notifications posted to this channel are shown on the lock screen in full or redacted form.

properties.name: name
properties.summary:
The visible name of this channel.
The recommended maximum length is 40 characters; the value may be truncated if it is too long.

properties.name: showBadge
properties.summary: Whether notifications posted to this channel can appear as application icon badges in a Launcher.

properties.name: sound
properties.summary: A URL to the sound to play.
properties.description:
The URL cannot refer to a file in the Resources directory, but it can refer to
a file in the raw resources directory
([Filesystem.resRawDirectory](api:Titanium.Filesystem#resRawDirectory)).

To create a raw resource, place the audio file in the `platform/android/res/raw`
folder and reference it as:

``` js
notificationChannel.sound = Ti.Filesystem.resRawDirectory + 'my_sound.wav';
```

properties.name: vibratePattern
properties.summary: The vibration pattern for notifications posted to this channel.
properties.description: Specify the pattern in milliseconds as an array. (e.g [100, 100, 100, 400, 400, 100, 100, 100])
